notes: Capture the Flag on Slayer's teams, rewritten as host rules: flags stand on Flag Spawn bricks in their team's colour; take an enemy flag to your own flag or a Flag Return Point to score; dropped flags go home after a while; /dropFlag drops a carried flag. The flag rides on the carrier's back in their team colour. Preferences start at Slayer CTF's defaults; the mini-game's owner or an admin changes them with /ctf <preference> <value>. Not ported yet: the Drop Tool key dropping the flag, the countdown over a dropped flag, the flag's light, brick events (onFlagPickedUp and the rest), locked flags, the score list columns and bots.
